claims.claim: OpenAI Platform bills per model usage, and prompts, completions, uploaded files, fine-tuning, and organization data can be sensitive.
claims.summary: The OpenAI API reference and Services Agreement describe a bearer-key-authenticated paid platform surface; prompts, completions, and organization data are user data.

claims.claim: Keep `OPENAI_API_KEY` (or `OPENAI_ADMIN_API_KEY` for organization administration Endpoints) out of source, shell history, inputs, logs, and chat.
claims.summary: The fixed openai/openai-openapi revision declares ApiKeyAuth and AdminApiKeyAuth HTTP bearer security schemes.

claims.claim: Responses, Chat Completions, Images, and Audio Endpoints support typed Server-Sent Events.
claims.summary: The fixed official revision declares text/event-stream responses on seven Endpoints (createResponse, createChatCompletion, createSpeech, createTranscription, createImage, createImageEdit, beta_createResponse).

claims.claim: Hub discovery is not an execution path: OpenAI calls stay caller-local and are paid provider traffic.
claims.summary: The product PontxSpec declares direct-only execution for every Endpoint (metadata.execution.enabled=false).
